cameraDeniedHelp: Check camera access for this site in your browser and device settings, then try again below. If access is blocked here, use a browser with camera access.
cameraUnavailableHelp: Check that a camera is connected and not in use by another app, then try again below. If this browser cannot use it, use another browser or device with a camera.
createContentHint: Add a note and 3–5 photographs. You’ll choose how they come together next.
signInToHistory: sign in to see your sends
homeExplanation: A real postcard. Your pictures and words, tucked behind it. A private memory for the person you have in mind.
homeAccountHint: Sign in to open your postcards or make something for someone.
accountVisitHint: Unlocked keys stay in memory for this visit. You can lock them or sign out when you’re done.
accountNext: what would you like to do?
recipientBody: Find them by their public handle, or make one for yourself.
recipientOnly: Only this account can open what you send.
createNoteHint: A few words to go with the pictures.
createFrontHint: Take a fresh picture of the front. This is how they’ll find the memory.
createSendHint: Photograph the postcard above before sending. Your content and composition are already selected.
createDraftHint: This draft is only here for this visit. Closing the page loses unsent work.
scanGuideHint: Keep the whole postcard in view, with even light.
scanAccountHint: You can open the camera now. Sign in and unlock your keys to open a matched postcard.
settingsAccountHint: Your public handle stays with this account.
languageHint: Choose the language for this browser.
accessUnavailable: Sending access is unavailable. No allowance or limit has been assumed.
accessRecord: Beta sends are unrestricted. Free allowances are not used in this mode.
accessLifetime: Lifetime access: unlimited sends to yourself and others.
accessLifetimeScope: Printing and postage are not included.
accessSeparate: The two allowances are separate and do not reset periodically.
accessAuthority: The server checks access when publishing. This view does not reserve a send or change your allowance.
sendLimitReached: The server declined this send because the sending limit was reached.
sendLimitHelp: Your draft remains here for this visit. This attempt will not be resent automatically. Separate limits apply to sends to yourself and others.
sendAccessUnavailable: Sending access could not be checked. Sending was not confirmed.
sendAccessUnavailableHelp: This is temporary unavailability, not an exhausted allowance. Your draft remains here for this visit. No automatic retry or refund is implied.
scanPreparing: Preparing the postcard on this device. Nothing is shown yet.
openChecking: Checking permission to open. Keep connected, or cancel.
openDenied: This postcard is no longer available to open. Nothing was shown.
openUnconfirmed: Opening could not be confirmed. Nothing was shown. Connect and try again; a previous request may already have been accepted.
openSignIn: Sign in to this account again before opening. Nothing was shown.
registrationPaused: New account setup is temporarily paused until the keys can be safely recovered after an interruption. No new account was created. You can still sign in to an existing account.
accountExistingOnly: Existing accounts can sign in and restore their saved keys. New account setup is currently paused.
accountWorking: Checking your account and saved keys…
identityContinuityMissing: This account has no saved recovery record and this tab does not hold its original keys. Signing in again cannot recreate them. No replacement keys will be made.
atomicUnreadableBody: Your device returned a created passkey, but this browser could not read its result. Setup cannot finish here. No replacement key has been created.
atomicUnsupportedBody: Your passkey was saved, but it cannot protect your content here. Account setup is incomplete.
atomicUnsupportedHint: Retrying may not help on this device or with this provider.
atomicResumeSavedHint: To return, open Account and continue with the same Google account and handle. The saved passkey will still need to pass verification.
atomicSignInBody: Continue with Google to find your account or begin a new one.
atomicHandleBody: This is how people find you. Choose a public handle you’ll want to keep.
atomicHandleHint: 3–30 letters, numbers, dots or underscores. Your handle becomes permanent when setup is complete.
atomicCreateBody: Save a passkey in your password manager or on your device. You’ll check it in a separate step next.
atomicCreating: Finish creating the passkey in the window from your device or password manager.
atomicVerifyBody: Now check that it can open your private memories. Select the same passkey you just created.
atomicVerifyHint: This opens your passkey manager once more. Your account is ready only after this check succeeds.
atomicPendingBody: Your passkey was created, but its connection to this account is not confirmed. Keep this page open and check that same passkey. Closing it may lose the information needed to finish linking.
atomicPrivacy: Your pictures and words stay encrypted. Only the person you choose can open them.
atomicSaving: Checking your passkey and saving your account…
atomicUnknown: The reply did not arrive. Your account may already be saved. Check the result or retry the same save; do not start a replacement.
atomicReauthenticate: Continue with Google again to safely find your account or resume setup. This does not replace saved keys.
atomicRestore: Your account is saved, but its keys are not open here yet. Sign in and open the saved keys with the same passkey.
atomicAssertion: Verify the same passkey again to continue saving these keys.
atomicTerminal: This unfinished setup expired or was cancelled. You can explicitly start a new setup; no saved account will be replaced.
atomicReady: Your saved keys have been checked. You are ready.
atomicLeaveHint: Leaving clears keys from this page. It cannot undo an account already saved. Continue with Google to find the result.
atomicUnavailable: Setup is unavailable right now. Existing accounts can still sign in.
atomicFailure: This step could not be completed. Your account is not ready here yet.
historyBody: Your sending history. Opening a memory still needs the physical postcard.
historyAuth: Sign in to see your sending history.
historyUnavailable: Your sending history couldn’t be loaded. Try again when you’re connected.
historyCopyFailed: Could not copy. You can select the code instead.
historyPolicy: You can cancel while this send is still eligible. Content already opened or copied cannot be taken back.
historyConflict: This send can no longer be cancelled. Refreshing its current state.
historyUnknown: Cancellation was not confirmed. The request will not be retried automatically. Check the refreshed state before deciding what to do.
historyUnsupported: state not supported by this app
recentBody: Choose a handle to look it up again, then confirm the recipient.
recentUnavailable: Recent recipients are unavailable. You can still enter a handle.
recentChanged: This handle no longer matches that recipient. Enter a handle and confirm it again.
shellReady: The app shell is available offline. Signing in, unlocking, scanning and sending still need a connection. Postcards and photos are not saved here.
shellPreparing: Preparing the app shell for another visit. You can keep using Remanence.
shellTestOnly: This TEST entry is online-only. Offline installation is disabled.
deploymentUnavailable: Account requests are paused: the configuration or connection could not be verified. Reconnect, finish any open work, close other Remanence tabs, then reload. Saved keys are not replaced.
shellTestOffline: You appear to be offline. This TEST entry needs a connection and is not saved for offline opening.
shellUnsupported: This browser cannot prepare an offline shell. You can use Remanence online.
shellUnavailable: The offline shell could not be prepared. You can keep using Remanence online.
shellOffline: You appear to be offline. The shell can open, but signing in, unlocking, scanning and sending need a connection.
shellUpdate: An update is ready. Finish what you are doing before closing all Remanence tabs and app windows, then open it again. Unsent drafts will be lost when you close.
shellInstallHelp: If your browser supports installation, use its install or add-to-home-screen menu. An install button appears here when the browser offers it.
shellInstalled: Remanence is running as an app, or installation has completed.
homeOpenBody: scan the picture side to open what they sent you.
homeMakeBody: put something together just for them.
authBody: use the account this postcard was addressed to.
phaseAuthenticated: signed in. the keys are still locked.
phaseUnlocked: keys are unlocked in memory for this visit.
phaseMatched: a postcard matched. the memory is not open yet.
scanWaiting: turn on the camera and take a picture of the postcard’s picture side.
linkRequired: this email already belongs to an account. a new one is not created.
upgradeRequired: this account needs the current app before it can continue here.
chooseHandle: choose a handle. it stays with this account.
handleTaken: that handle is already taken. nothing was created, and these keys are still here.
handleInvalid: use 3 to 30 letters, digits, dots, or underscores.
registrationFailed: the account was not created. the same registration can be tried again.
prfUnavailable: This passkey did not provide the encryption support needed here. Retrying may not help on this device or with this provider.
passkeyCancelled: The passkey step did not finish. You can try again when you’re ready.
passkeyUnavailable: this browser cannot use a passkey.
savePasskey: save a passkey for these keys
identityAbsent: this tab no longer has the keys from registration. a new key is not created.
recoveryCodeHint: write this code down. it is shown once and is not saved in the browser.
recoveryPending: a passkey was saved, and opening the keys is not finished. another one is not created.
wrongPasskey: that passkey does not belong to this account.
googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not available from this page.
cameraHeld: the picture stays on this device. a memory is not open.
cameraUnavailable: The camera isn’t available right now.
sheetUnavailable: the sheet could not be prepared and was not saved.
sheetSaveFailed: the sheet could not be saved. try again.
recognitionUnavailable: recognition is not available in this browser yet. the picture was not matched.
ambiguousMatch: could not identify one postcard. nothing was opened.
chooseSender: this postcard came from several people. whose capsule should open?
emptyIndex: there is no incoming postcard on this account.
bodyMissing: the postcard was recognized, and its sealed body is not here.
integrityFailed: the sealed postcard did not check out. it was not opened.
keysLocked: unlock the keys for this account before a scan can open anything.
scanCancelled: the scan stopped before a memory was opened.
incompleteIndex: not all postcards could be loaded, so nothing was opened. try again.
scanRetake: this picture could not be processed for a scan. take another picture.
syncRejected: the incoming list could not be checked.
createLocked: Sign in and unlock your account first. Then choose who this is for.
recipientNotFound: that handle is not on Remanence.
recipientHeld: this person is set for this visit. nothing is sent, and the picture side is not captured yet.
recipientRejected: that directory reply could not be used.
selfRejected: this account could not be used as the recipient.
frontHeld: this picture stays on this device for this person. it is not sent, and it is not a fingerprint.
frontWorking: preparing this picture on this device. nothing is sent yet.
frontReady: postcard prepared on this device. it is not sent, and nothing was matched.
frontScanFailed: could not read a postcard from this picture. try again with the card filling the frame.
noteTooLong: this note is over 1000 UTF-8 bytes. it stays here to edit, and it is not part of the card.
photoCount: Choose 3 to 5 photos. They stay in this draft until you send.
photoRejected: that file could not be added as a photo. JPEG up to 64 MB, or five photos are already here.
createComposeFailed: these photos could not be prepared for the card. add them again.
musicCoverLater: a cover can be added later. it is not loaded in this browser.
musicNoCover: this recording has no cover. the title stays.
musicRejected: that music reply could not be used.
musicUnavailable: music search is not available right now.
musicNotSent: the chosen song stays on this device for this visit. nothing is sent, and no catalog is downloaded.
sendNotSent: not sent. this attempt stopped during local preparation.
sendDraftFailed: the server returned an error while creating the postcard.
sendNotConfirmed: sending was not confirmed. the postcard may have been sent.
sendWorkingHelp: leaving Create does not guarantee that sending is cancelled.
sendLocalHelp: this attempt is finished. You can leave this screen. To try again, reopen Create and prepare the composition and front photo again.
sendUncertainHelp: do not send another copy because of this error. You can leave this screen without retrying. Leaving does not undo work on the server.
settingsBody: Your account, language, and this browser.
settingsSignedOut: not signed in on this device.
